theorem bbolt.Mergepgids.wp_proof : bbolt.Mergepgids.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.Mergepgids.spec`, unfolded:

    xs.length + ys.length ≤ ds.length →
      bbolt.PgidsSorted xs →
        bbolt.PgidsSorted ys →
          ⊢
            ∀ Φ,
              isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.bbolt.internal.common ∗
                  ownSlice dst ds (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ownSlice a xs qa ∗ ownSlice b ys qb -∗
                (▷
                    ∀ out,
                      ⌜bbolt.PgidsSorted out ∧ out.Perm (xs ++ ys)⌝ ∗
                          ownSlice dst (out ++ List.drop (xs.length + ys.length) ds) (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                            ownSlice a xs qa ∗ ownSlice b ys qb -∗
                        Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                  WP
                    ((((intoVal (functions go_etcd_io.bbolt.internal.common.Mergepgids [])) (intoVal dst)) (intoVal a))
                      (intoVal b))
                    {{ Φ }}

def bbolt.mergeInv (dst a b : GoSlice) (xs ys : List w64) (qa qb : DFrac) (lead_ptr follow_ptr
    merged_ptr : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ L F k ls fs ms junk qL qF,
      "lead" ∷ typedPointsto lead_ptr L (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "follow" ∷ typedPointsto follow_ptr F (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          "merged" ∷ typedPointsto merged_ptr (slice.slice dst w64 (W64 0) k) (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            "HL" ∷ ownSlice L ls qL ∗
              "HF" ∷ ownSlice F fs qF ∗
                "Hback" ∷ (ownSlice L ls qL -∗ ownSlice F fs qF -∗ ownSlice a xs qa ∗ ownSlice b ys qb) ∗
                  "HM" ∷ ownSlice (slice.slice dst w64 (W64 0) k) ms (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                    "Hjunk" ∷ ownSlice (slice.slice dst w64 k (a.len + b.len)) junk (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                      "%Hpure" ∷
                        ⌜0 ≤ sint.Z k ∧
                            ls ≠ [] ∧
                              fs ≠ [] ∧
                                bbolt.PgidsSorted ms ∧
                                  bbolt.PgidsSorted ls ∧
                                    bbolt.PgidsSorted fs ∧
                                      (∀ (x : w64), x ∈ ms → ∀ (y : w64), y ∈ ls ++ fs → uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z y) ∧
                                        (ms ++ ls ++ fs).Perm (xs ++ ys)⌝)
